A structured and analytical way of approaching technical problems. A practical mindset and an interest in working directly with technical products and equipment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. An eye for detail and the ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying causes. A proactive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues from different disciplines. A good command of English, both written and spoken.
